Definition: of Hebrew origin (H5818); Ozias (i.e. Uzzijah), an Israelite:--Ozias.
BiblicalUsage: Ozias is the Greek form of Uzziah, king of Judah, named twice in Matthew's genealogy: Ozias begat Joatham, and Joatham begat Achaz, in the line that runs from David to Jesus. He reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem, and his pride cost him the temple.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ozias is Uzziah the king, and his place in the genealogy shows that God works through kings who failed as well as kings who were faithful.
